# Quality attributes: __APP__ (prototype name, or app-wide)

Per prototype in phase 1, app-wide in phase 2. Candidates come from the needs, implicit attributes and the risk list. Kept only if they pass all three criteria: (1) a design consideration outside the domain, (2) shapes the structure of the design, (3) critical or important to success. Security always stays.
